description: Source code for user management in Mattermost, including user creation, retrieval, update, MFA handling, and cache invalidation.

classes.name: UserCreateOptions
classes.description: Options for creating a user, including guest status and import source.

methods.name: CreateUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with options for guest and import, assigns roles, checks domain restrictions, and sets locale.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Internal method to persist a user, validate password, verify email, and send welcome email if applicable.

methods.name: verifyUserEmail
methods.description: Verifies a user's email address in the store.

methods.name: GetUser
methods.description: Retrieves a user by ID.

methods.name: GetUsers
methods.description: Retrieves multiple users by their IDs.

methods.name: GetUserByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves a user by username.

methods.name: GetUserByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a user by email.

methods.name: GetUserByRemoteID
methods.description: Retrieves a user by remote ID.

methods.name: GetUserByAuth
methods.description: Retrieves a user by authentication data and service.

methods.name: GetUsersFromProfiles
methods.description: Retrieves user profiles based on options.

methods.name: GetUsersByUsernames
methods.description: Retrieves profiles for given usernames with view restrictions.

methods.name: GetUsersPage
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users, optionally as admin.

methods.name: GetUsersEtag
methods.description: Generates an ETag for user list based on privacy settings and restrictions.

methods.name: GetUsersByIds
methods.description: Retrieves user profiles by IDs with cache allowance and admin view.

methods.name: GetUsersInTeam
methods.description: Retrieves users in a specific team.

methods.name: GetUsersNotInTeam
methods.description: Retrieves users not in a specific team.

methods.name: GetUsersInTeamPage
methods.description: Retrieves users in a team with pagination, optionally as admin.

methods.name: GetUsersNotInTeamPage
methods.description: Retrieves users not in a team with pagination, optionally as admin.

methods.name: GetUsersInTeamEtag
methods.description: Generates an ETag for users in a team.

methods.name: GetUsersNotInTeamEtag
methods.description: Generates an ETag for users not in a team.

methods.name: GetUsersWithoutTeamPage
methods.description: Retrieves users without a team with pagination, optionally as admin.

methods.name: GetUsersWithoutTeam
methods.description: Retrieves users without a team.

methods.name: UpdateUser
methods.description: Updates user information.

methods.name: UpdateUserNotifyProps
methods.description: Updates notification properties for a user.

methods.name: DeactivateAllGuests
methods.description: Deactivates all guest users.

methods.name: DeactivateMagicLinkGuests
methods.description: Deactivates guests with magic links.

methods.name: InvalidateCacheForUser
methods.description: Invalidates cache for a specific user and notifies cluster.

methods.name: GenerateMfaSecret
methods.description: Generates MFA secret and QR code for a user.

methods.name: ActivateMfa
methods.description: Activates MFA for a user with a token.

methods.name: DeactivateMfa
methods.description: Deactivates MFA for a user.

methods.name: PromoteGuestToUser
methods.description: Promotes a guest user to a regular user.

methods.name: DemoteUserToGuest
methods.description: Demotes a user to a guest.
